summary: Nine metres of west kerb outside a cafe by Taringa station.
reasons: Cafe and station beside it, no dwelling under 10 m
Apartments 11 m away on same side
Cars already park at this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Cafe 0-3 m is non-residential; apartments 11 m behind it, other homes 17 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars are parked at this kerb; stretch is only about a van length with a narrow footpath beside it.
drivers.traffic: Through street next to the station and park 'n' ride; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 1/4P and no stopping on weekday mornings.

flags: Short section, barely one van length
sun_shade: Open to the sky; tree shade from the east side of the street in the afternoon.

best_section.where: West kerb outside the Scatter Bean cafe, just south of Taringa station
